title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. THE BACK OF YOU. GLUTE BRIDGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, REVERSE LUNGES, STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH, CAT-COW, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH. BUILD THE ENGINE ROOM, THEN UNKINK THE DESK CHAIR OUT OF IT.

script.welcome: WEDNESDAY, GRIMES. HUMP DAY, AND WE ARE TRAINING THE HUMP. GLUTES, HAMSTRINGS, BALANCE, THEN WE OPEN THE BACK AND THE HIPS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. THAT CHAIR HAS BEEN SQUASHING YOUR BACKSIDE FLAT FOR THIRTY YEARS. TODAY WE FIGHT BACK. UP. MOVE.
script.rest: REST. DO NOT CHECK YOUR PHONE. IT IS NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NEITHER ARE YOU.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT COUNT. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. GLUTES FIRED, HAMSTRINGS LENGTHENED, BALANCE TESTED, BACK AND HIPS OPEN. THAT IS HOW A MAN STAYS ON HIS OWN TWO FEET AT NINETY. NOW GO EAT A LUNCH WITH SOME BLOODY PROTEIN IN IT.
script.pause: HOLD. AND KEEP YOUR HAND OUT OF THE CRACKER BOX.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT AND HIP-WIDTH. PRESS THROUGH THE HEELS AND SQUEEZE THE GLUTES TO LIFT THE HIPS UNTIL KNEES, HIPS AND SHOULDERS LINE UP. PAUSE 2 SECONDS AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. RIBS DOWN, NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. ON YOUR BACK. THREE ROUNDS. TWELVE REPS. HEELS DOWN, SQUEEZE THE BACKSIDE, HIPS UP. PAUSE AT THE TOP FOR TWO. THAT IS YOUR ARSE DOING A JOB FOR ONCE INSTEAD OF HOLDING UP A CHAIR.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. ENGINE ROOM SWITCHED ON. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: STAND TALL NEAR THE WALL OR CHAIR FOR A FINGERTIP IF NEEDED. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. HINGE AT THE HIP, TORSO FORWARD AS THE FREE LEG REACHES BACK, BACK FLAT, HIPS SQUARE. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU STAY STEADY. SQUEEZE THE GLUTE TO STAND.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. YOUR BALANCE TEST. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE. HINGE FROM THE HIP, LEG BACK, BACK FLAT. FINGERTIP ON THE WALL IF YOU MUST. A WOBBLE IS FINE. A TOPPLE IS COMEDY.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. BOTH FEET DOWN. SHAKE IT OUT.
exercises.speakDone: HINGES DONE. STEADY ON YOUR PINS. GOOD MAN.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL, HAND ON THE WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK AND LOWER UNTIL THE BACK KNEE HOVERS ABOVE THE FLOOR, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. DRIVE THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. CONTROLLED, NO CRASHING.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK, LOWER SLOW, FRONT HEEL DRIVES YOU UP. HAND ON THE WALL IF YOU NEED IT. NO KNEELING DOWN FOR A REST, THIS IS NOT CHURCH.
exercises.speakDone: LUNGES DONE. LEGS EARNED THEIR KEEP. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON THE BOTTOM STAIR, LEG STRAIGHT BUT KNEE NOT LOCKED, TOES UP. HAND ON THE RAIL. HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS WITH A LONG FLAT BACK UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. NO ROUNDING, NO BOUNCING. BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH. HEEL ON THE BOTTOM STAIR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. FLAT BACK, HINGE FORWARD, BREATHE. DO NOT BOUNCE. YOU ARE A MAN, NOT A SPRING.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. BREATHE IN: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAILBONE (COW). BREATHE OUT: ROUND THE BACK TOWARD THE CEILING, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH PER MOVE.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. ON ALL FOURS. TWO ROUNDS. EIGHT SLOW. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK UP LIKE AN ANGRY TOMCAT. YOUR FAVOURITE. DO NOT GET SENTIMENTAL.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.

exercises.name: HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEELING, ONE KNEE DOWN (CUSHION IT), OTHER FOOT FLAT IN FRONT. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE GLUTE OF THE DOWN LEG, SHIFT HIPS GENTLY FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE HIP. REACH THAT SIDE'S ARM UP. HOLD 30, SWITCH. HAND ON A CHAIR IF NEEDED.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. HALF KNEELING. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. TUCK THE TAIL, SQUEEZE THE BACKSIDE, HIPS FORWARD, ARM UP. THIS UNDOES EIGHT HOURS OF SITTING FOLDED UP LIKE A DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. ON YOUR FEET AND GO EARN YOUR LUNCH.
